import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet2']

for i in range(2, 93):
    f = ('=IF(AND(COUNTIFS($E$2:$E$92,$E{r},$B$2:$B$92,$B{r},$C$2:$C$92,"Sick Day")>0,'
         'COUNTIFS($E$2:$E$92,$E{r},$B$2:$B$92,$B{r},$D$2:$D$92,"Overtime")>0,'
         '$E{r}<>$E{p}),"y","")').format(r=i, p=i-1)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=6).value = f

wb.save('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
print("done")
